Purpose: Hero image for a post about modelling engineering intent as structured records, and how that structure made agent guidance measurable

Character.Description: A highly competent, focused woman coder and systems thinker

Face.Makeup: Bold, pinks or purples, with a touch of shimmer

Base.Name: Dark blazer
Base.Description: Professional dark blazer over tech-casual attire, sleeves pushed up
Base.Context: Always present, bridges corporate and technical worlds

Style.Rendering: High-detail digital painting, photorealistic, concept art quality

ColorPalette.Treatment: High saturation on the structured side, deliberately desaturated grey on the prose side

Atmosphere.Mood: Analytical, electric, the quiet of noticing something you weren't looking for

Situation.Name: Where the Prose Resolves
Situation.Setting: A darkened studio workspace dominated by one enormous holographic display wall split into two halves. The LEFT half is a dense, softly-blurred wall of running prose — grey-white paragraphs of guidance text, uncountable, edges bleeding into haze, no structure anywhere in it. The RIGHT half is the same knowledge resolved into a crisp grid of discrete glowing record cards, each card showing six short labelled rows stacked vertically. Down the middle runs a visible resolution seam where the blurred prose crystallizes into hard card edges, like fog condensing into lattice.
Situation.Camera: Wide mid-shot. Subject stands off-centre in the left third, turned three-quarters away from camera toward the display wall, which fills the right two-thirds of frame. Haze and negative space across the upper left for text overlay.

CharacterPose.Expression: Focused concentration giving way to recognition — eyes narrowed on one small detail, the particular stillness of noticing something she did not set out to find
CharacterPose.BodyPosition: Standing close to the display wall, weight settled, shoulders squared to the structured half
CharacterPose.Gesture: Holding a plain flat steel ruler horizontally against the display, its straight edge laid across one record card and spanning that card's full width

Character.Name: Dark blazer
Character.Description: Sleeves pushed up to the forearm

Character.Name: Professional glasses
Character.Application: Worn; the six-row card structure reflected small and sharp in the lenses

Article.Name: Wall of unstructured prose
Article.Description: Dense grey-white running paragraphs, deliberately soft-focus and dull, no headings, no edges, extending past the frame
Article.Application: Fills the left half of the display wall, visibly duller and flatter than the right
Article.SymbolicMeaning: Guidance you cannot decompose, select from, or measure

Article.Name: Grid of six-field intent records
Article.Description: Discrete glowing cards in a neat lattice, each showing six short labelled rows in sequence, cyan edges, crisp and countable
Article.Application: Fills the right half of the display wall, receding in perspective
Article.SymbolicMeaning: The same judgement made structural — capability, threat, expectation, strategy, evidence, tradeoff

Article.Name: Flat steel ruler
Article.Description: A plain flat steel machinist's rule — a simple straightedge, rectangular, with clear engraved tick marks and numerals along one edge. Deliberately simple geometry: no hinges, jaws, dials, or moving parts of any kind
Article.Application: Held level in one hand and laid flat across the display, its edge spanning the full width of the single record card whose evidence row is lit lime green — every other row on the wall stays cyan
Article.SymbolicMeaning: The evidence field was written to be a measurement specification, and here it is being used as one

Article.Name: Two small result fragments
Article.Description: Two faint floating file-tree slivers low in the frame, one reading a conventional tests directory, one reading a spec file sitting beside its module
Article.Application: Small, dim, lower right, well below the caliper — present but not competing
Article.SymbolicMeaning: The measured difference between guided and unguided work

Environment.Name: Darkened studio
Environment.Description: Matte black floor and walls with faint reflections of the display wall
Environment.Application: Surrounds the scene, keeps all light sourced from the panels

KeyDetails: The left half of the wall is measurably duller and softer than the right — the eye should read the right side as resolved and the left as fog
Exactly one card on the wall has a row lit lime green: the card the ruler is spanning
The ruler is a plain flat straightedge with tick marks, held level and square to the card — simple, rigid, unambiguous, with no moving parts
The ruler is the one physical, mechanical object in a frame otherwise full of holograms
Her attention is on the single card she is measuring, not on the wall as a whole
Situation.LightingFocus: Cool cyan dominant from the structured record grid, a flat desaturated grey wash from the prose half, and one small lime-green highlight from the measured row catching the brushed steel of the ruler and the edge of her glasses

ArticleContext.Title: Modelling Engineering Intent Made My Guidance Measurable
Themes: prose has no unit of measure
specificity is what makes measurement possible
the evidence field was a test spec all along
